title: Freeze Scene · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Freeze Scene · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on familiar places such as a library or a kitchen. The lead makes a frozen pose that suggests a place, without speaking or touching anyone. The others identify the place. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Freeze Scene, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
